settings.aboutDescription: [TR] FloPOS is a free forever, open-source restaurant POS for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, food trucks, cloud kitchens, and bars. It includes ordering, tables, menus, kitchen display, receipt printing, staff access, and local data storage. Download it, run service, keep your data, and own your POS.
settings.anonymousTelemetryHint: [TR] When enabled, sends anonymous, non-identifying usage pings (like app launches) so we know FloCafe is being used. Never includes store data, sales, or anything that could identify your business. Independent of cloud sync — sent even if cloud sync is off. You made this choice during setup; change it anytime here.

setup.anonymousDataFields: [TR] Country, app version, device platform, session duration, feature usage counts, and error diagnostics. Never your customer names, order contents, phone numbers, emails, payment details, or staff passwords.
setup.chooseCountryHint: [TR] FloCafe uses your country to pick the right currency, tax format, and demo data.
setup.chooseLanguageHint: [TR] Pick the language for this setup flow before choosing the country.
setup.cloudEnableHint: [TR] Cloud Services are optional and disabled by default. Enable them to connect FloCafe with FloAdmin for features such as RevFlo reporting, device pairing, and supported account services.
setup.cloudRecoveryNoteDisabled: [TR] Cloud services are disabled. Password recovery on this install relies on the Master PIN set in the previous step. If you forget both your password and the Master PIN, recovery requires local database reinitialization (Settings → Database Tools), which erases local data after a forced backup.
setup.cloudRecoveryNoteEnabled: [TR] Email-based password reset requires cloud services to be enabled and reachable. Note: this app build does not yet perform the cloud-assisted email recovery step — Master PIN recovery is what's actually available today.
setup.cloudSubtitle: [TR] Optional. Self-hosted or custom deployments can point this at their own server instead of the default Flo cloud.
setup.cloudManagedAutomaticallyDescription: [TR] FloCafe connects automatically so RevFlo pairing and support work without a manual approval step.
setup.cloudUrlHint: [TR] Prefilled with the default Flo cloud server. Editable for self-hosted or custom deployments.
setup.cloudUrlHttpsRequired: [TR] Cloud server URL must use HTTPS (or local HTTP for development)
setup.cloudUrlInvalid: [TR] Please enter a valid Cloud server URL
setup.demoDesc: [TR] Sample data for training and testing.
setup.demoDetails: [TR] Seeds products, tables, sample customers, and staff users so the client can explore the system.
setup.emptyDesc: [TR] Owner account and required settings only.
setup.emptyDetails: [TR] Use this when the client wants to enter every product, table, and customer manually.
setup.errorNameRequired: [TR] Name, email, and password are required
setup.errorPasswordRequirementsNotMet: [TR] Password must be at least 8 characters long and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.
setup.errorTermsRequired: [TR] You must agree to the Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, and No Warranty Disclaimer to continue
setup.emailCommunicationDescription: [TR] We will send a welcome email immediately so you can verify this address. Essential account, service, and security notices are not promotional and cannot be disabled here.
setup.expressDetails: [TR] Seeds basic food and beverage categories, a few starter products, and tables for FineDine.
setup.finedineDetails: [TR] Best for restaurants that seat guests, manage tables, and collect payment after service.
setup.flowSubtitle: [TR] FloCafe is restaurant-only. Pick the billing model for this outlet.
setup.marketingOptional: [TR] Receive marketing messages, offers, and surveys (optional)
setup.productUpdatesOptional: [TR] Receive product updates and release notes (optional)
setup.masterPinNotAvailable: [TR] Master PIN protection isn't available on this device. You can continue without it.
setup.masterPinRecoveryNote: [TR] This PIN also lets you recover access later if you ever forget your login password — from the login screen, choose "Forgot password? Recover access" and enter this PIN with your email to set a new password.
setup.masterPinRequired: [TR] Set a 4-digit Master PIN to continue
setup.ownerEmailDomainWarning: [TR] This email domain may not receive mail. You can continue, but critical software notices and account recovery messages may not reach you.
setup.ownerSubtitle: [TR] This first user gets full owner access on this POS.
setup.qsrDetails: [TR] Best for quick-service restaurants where payment is taken before fulfilment.
setup.setMasterPinDescription: [TR] A 4-digit PIN known only to you, required to back up, restore, or initialize this database — separate from your login password. If you forget it, you can reset it later from Settings while logged in as owner.
setup.setupDataSubtitle: [TR] Select how much data should be created on first launch.
setup.tagline: [TR] Create the owner account and choose the restaurant setup.
setup.timezoneHint: [TR] Pre-filled from your country. Stores in multi-timezone countries can choose their actual local timezone.
